LanguageData.RatkinQL_GratefulTree_Report: A ratkin paid a visit to repay an old debt.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Grateful_Greeting: A ratkin stands at the gate, ears low, clutching a small pouch. "I have not forgotten what {Interviewer_labelShort} did for my kin. Please, let me repay that kindness."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Grateful_OptBack: Return to the matter at hand.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Grateful_Story1: "That blizzard, three winters ago? My family was caught outside. Your people opened the door when no one else would."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Grateful_Story2: "A Rakinia caravan lay bleeding on the road. Your medic bound their wounds and gave them water. I was that caravan's lead."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Grateful_Story3: "My little brother had a fever that wouldn't break. Your doctor sat up all night with herbs and a wet cloth. He still speaks of that kindness."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Grateful_Farewell: "May your fields stay fertile and your hearth never go cold." He bows once, then vanishes into the tall grass.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Grateful_MsgAccept: Beaming, the ratkin presses a bag of silver into your hands. "It's not much, but it's from the heart."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Grateful_MsgDecline: He stands still for a moment, then bows low. "Then I will remember your humility as well as your help."
